Author: namibj
Content:
I'm looking forward to getting a bond tester unit with a "programmable precision voltage supply" add-on "dongle" (the dongle made and ordered; the tester with the dongle programmed) to do retention (and with it, power-up-bit-pattern) tests on some of the dies (especially if I can get the dongle to someone who has a bond tester unit and access to a bunch of the dies and time to cycle a few dozen through it (technically should only take like 5 minutes or thereabouts at a single temperature)).
That's for FlexMem, Stef's SRAM generator. 
Technically that covers 5V and two DRC variants of 3.3V SRAM.
And it's pretty much the densest flexible/varied SRAM we have access to without signing any NDAs.
